# DurablFi

> Independent DeFi risk and yield research.

DurablFi publishes hand-written scorecards that explain yield sources, failure paths, dependencies, and plain-English verdicts. The research is educational and is not financial advice.

## Public sections

- [Homepage](https://3000-idaii2k9jko2fo7bp9p2d-5308ff07.us4.manus.computer/): DurablFi overview and latest scorecard previews.
- [Free Scorecards](https://3000-idaii2k9jko2fo7bp9p2d-5308ff07.us4.manus.computer/scorecards): Browse current published records.
- [Scorecard Library](https://3000-idaii2k9jko2fo7bp9p2d-5308ff07.us4.manus.computer/archive): Public library with filters and sorting.
- [Articles](https://3000-idaii2k9jko2fo7bp9p2d-5308ff07.us4.manus.computer/articles): Separate independent editorial section; no articles are published yet.
- [Methodology](https://3000-idaii2k9jko2fo7bp9p2d-5308ff07.us4.manus.computer/methodology): High-level explanation of the DurablFi risk approach.
- [Privacy Policy](https://3000-idaii2k9jko2fo7bp9p2d-5308ff07.us4.manus.computer/privacy): Email capture, optional analytics, cookies, and privacy practices.
